name: ai-estimate-studio
description: Configurable visual quotation platform for home-improvement businesses.

scripts.docs:check: pnpm docs:lint && pnpm docs:links && pnpm docs:openapi && pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:artifact
scripts.docs:lint: markdownlint-cli2 README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md docs/**/*.md
scripts.docs:openapi: cross-env NPM_CONFIG_LOGLEVEL=error redocly lint --config docs/api/redocly.yaml docs/api/openapi.yaml
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up --detach --wait postgres minio mailpit
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs scripts docs/.vitepress/config.mts --max-warnings 0 && turbo run lint
